signature: SUBROUTINE ZUNMTR( SIDE, UPLO, TRANS, M, N, A, LDA, TAU, C, LDC,

params.name: side
params.reference:
-   `= 'L'`: apply Q or $Q^H$ from the Left;
-   `= 'R'`: apply Q or $Q^H$ from the Right.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A contains elementary reflectors from ZHETRD;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A contains elementary reflectors from ZHETRD.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: No transpose, apply Q;
-   `= 'C'`: Conjugate transpose, apply $Q^H$.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix C. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix C. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: (`LDA`,N) if `SIDE = 'R'` The vectors which define the elementary reflectors, as returned by ZHETRD.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$ if `SIDE = 'L'`; $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$ if `SIDE = 'R'`.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: (N-1) if `SIDE = 'R'` `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i), as returned by ZHETRD.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by $Q \, C$ or $Q^H \, C$ or $C \, Q^H$ or $C \, Q$.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,N)$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,M)$. For optimum performance $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N \, \mathrm{NB}$ if `SIDE = 'L'`, and $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge M \, \mathrm{NB}$ if `SIDE = 'R'`, where NB is the optimal blocksize.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
